Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0019 2026-10-17
SHIFT NOTES — Weekend Controls Desk Coverage Gap
Date: 2026-10-17
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
07:15 — Weekend desk note from PERSON-0025 for TEAM-0001. The
controls coverage plan needs a confirmed relief role before
the morning coordinator leaves. ISSUE-0061, TASK-0159, and
TASK-0160 are the locating references for papers to include in
the coverage conversation.
08:10 — Ask the station roster clerk to confirm the relief
arrangement by 09:30. If no receiver can be named, put the
uncovered interval on the striped roster insert and take it to
the duty chair. Do not leave a blank interval that looks like
an intentional pause in service.
09:45 — Use receiver echo when the relief desk accepts the
next coordination action: the receiver repeats that action and
its due date. Keep the response beside the interval on the
roster. This confirms desk coverage without inventing a person
assignment for a task.
10:00 — Keep the program's weekend contact round on the desk
diary, with the later round at 14:00. If relief is still
unsettled, the duty chair must name who will hold those
contact rounds and where the call notes will be filed.
Next-shift list
— Carry the striped roster insert until coverage has a named
receiver.
Retain the chair's coverage decision with the original
interval.
Check the weekend call notes before starting the afternoon
contact round.
D. Worker 0025
Demo Worker 0025, Demo Team 01
